_comment: The llama-server flags gatto writes into a profile that a later engine build no longer accepts, each with the build that retired it and its replacement.
Read from each build's --help. b10703 added -lm and --lazy-mode and printed the old load-mode flags as deprecated in favour of --load-mode; b11071 removed them and refuses them at start.

A profile carrying a retired flag is rewritten to the replacement, order kept, when its engine moves to a build at or past retired_in. An empty replacement drops the flag, because it spelled the default.

Hand-reviewed at the pin, like families.json and streamed-tensors.json: a test holds reviewed_release equal to the engine pin, so an engine bump fails the build until someone re-reads the new build's help.
spelling is how the pinned build names the load mode and the lazy mode, which the scaffold writes into every new profile.
